experiment_data.hypothesis: 8B Cell C episode-level with use_ref=False (releasing ~8 GiB/GPU from ref model) and gpu_memory_utilization=0.20 will resolve the Catch-22 OOM: FSDP+ref baseline ~90 GiB/GPU leaves no room for VLLM. Removing ref model is the only viable fix since batch/token params were already minimized in v1-v3 and gpu_memory_utilization=0.15 was too low for VLLM init in v4.
